what: The sample size is always exact
title: Validation
text: average: always. Ten thousand selections, every one exactly expected hits asked .
code: frame <- data.frame(size = rlnorm(150, 2)) n_hits <- replicate(10000, {   s <- chromy_sample(frame, n = 23, size = "size")   sum(s$sample$hits) }) table(n_hits) #> n_hits #>    23  #> 10000

title: Validation
text: unit, fraction selections hit must converge expected hits. largest absolute deviation whole frame, Monte Carlo error sit within: Figure chunk unbiased-plot
code: lambda <- expected_hits(frame$size, 23) hits <- matrix(0L, 4000, nrow(frame)) for (r in seq_len(nrow(hits))) {   s <- chromy_sample(frame, n = 23, size = "size")   hits[r, s$sample$unit] <- s$sample$hits } observed <- colMeans(hits) mc_se <- sqrt(lambda * (1 - lambda) / nrow(hits))  max(abs(observed - lambda)) #> [1] 0.01554681 max(abs(observed - lambda) / pmax(mc_se, 1e-6))   # in Monte Carlo SEs #> [1] 2.430212 plot(lambda, observed,   xlab = "expected hits", ylab = "observed frequency",   pch = 16, col = "#35508C88", cex = 0.7 ) abline(0, 1, col = "#D9962E", lwd = 1.5)

title: Validation
text: Hits never stray one expectation, including units expected :
code: heavy <- data.frame(size = c(900, 500, rlnorm(60, 2))) ok <- replicate(2000, {   s <- chromy_sample(heavy, n = 12, size = "size",                      min_replacement = TRUE)   all(s$sample$hits == floor(s$sample$expected_hits) |       s$sample$hits == ceiling(s$sample$expected_hits)) }) all(ok) #> [1] TRUE

what: The estimator is unbiased and the variance honest
title: Validation
text: multiplicity estimator must centre true total; successive-difference variance unbiasedness promise systematic-like design, sit near Monte Carlo variance — err conservative side serpentine order carries real structure. ratio near one says successive-difference variance fair report; one, conservative one.
code: pop <- data.frame(   stratum = rep(sprintf("s%02d", 1:10), each = 30),   size    = rlnorm(300, 2) ) pop$y <- 50 + 10 * pop$size + rnorm(300, sd = 15) truth <- sum(pop$y)  runs <- t(replicate(2000, {   s <- chromy_sample(pop, n = 50, size = "size",                      order_by = c("stratum", "chromy_size"))   e <- estimate_total(s, "y")   c(total = e$total, var = e$se^2) }))  c(   relative_bias   = mean(runs[, "total"]) / truth - 1,   empirical_var   = var(runs[, "total"]),   mean_sd_var     = mean(runs[, "var"]),   variance_ratio  = mean(runs[, "var"]) / var(runs[, "total"]) ) #>  relative_bias  empirical_var    mean_sd_var variance_ratio  #>   5.229982e-04   2.682902e+06   4.660619e+06   1.737156e+00
